about_the_game:
A collector's dream! A compilation consisting of two cult-classic Indonesian horror titles: DreadOut and DreadOut: Keepers of The Dark, remastered and bundled in one package for a smoother, modern gameplay experience.

Originally released between 2014 and 2016, both titles have been enhanced with improved visuals, controls, and overall performance. Now available on PC in one unified launcher, with console versions also supported.

Why This Collection?

More Flexibility! With this release, we want to offer more options to players. If you only want one of the titles, the remastered versions of DreadOut and Keepers of The Dark are still available separately. But for those who are new to the series or missed the original releases, we could say that this collection is a more convenient way to experience both games together in a single launcher.

What’s New in the Remastered Version?

Key Improvements

  • Launcher Scene: Access both games from a single interface.

  • Improved Controls: Optimized for modern systems.

  • Enhanced Graphics: Ambient Occlusion, Motion Blur, Bloom, and SMAA added.

Visual Updates

  • New Brightness System: Enhanced lighting using post-processing.

  • Updated UI: Full-screen warning menu for consistency.

Gameplay Enhancements

  • Camera Upgrades: Better aiming, tuned sensitivity, smoother DSLR control.

  • Animation Fixes: Analog input now affects animations properly.

  • Improved Analog Input: Tighter movement and reduced drifting.

UI and Navigation

  • Gallery System: System tab replaced with Start-accessible Gallery.

Enemy Behavior Fixes

  • Koil Fight: Fixed NPCs stuck in respawn loop.

  • Mirror Entity: Removed unused mirror mechanic.

  • Water Ghost: Fixed teleporting issue in water stage.

Now with More Languages

Expanded localization support for more players:

  • Korean

  • Traditional Chinese

  • Portuguese

  • French

Steam Deck Verified

Steam Deck optimization is in progress, with full verification targeted in the near future!

***

About DreadOut

DreadOut is a third person supernatural horror game where you play as Linda, a high school student trapped in an old, abandoned town. Equipped with her trusty smartphone and an SLR camera, she will battle against terrifying encounters and solve mysterious puzzles which will ultimately determine her fate.

Help her overcome the challenges that will stand before her. Survive the Dread!

When a group of high school students went astray from a field trip, they came across something totally unexpected. A town long forgotten, trapped in a peaceful state of slumber. What they did not realize was what lurks within. And what seemed like an innocent stroll turns into disaster as the secluded town reveals its dark and terrible secrets. The presence of sinister forces from beyond their realm of existence.

It all comes down to Linda. She will experience stirrings of unfamiliar powers, emerging from within her. These newfound abilities might just be the only way she can save her own life and those of her friends.

About DreadOut: Keepers of the Dark

DreadOut: Keepers of the Dark is a new standalone horror game that takes place in the DreadOut universe. In this missing chapter, you will help Linda face the challenges of the DreadOut world with even more dangers lurking within.

Follow the event in which Linda was transported by The Mysterious Lady in Red into The Mirror Realm. A portal of worlds that connects it to 8 haunted dominions where 13+ horrific ghosts are ready to greet her in the most terrifying way possible. They will stop at nothing to thwart your main objective: To survive!

So, get your smart phone and SLR camera ready and choose your path wisely. The doors you open will decide the outcome of Linda’s fate.

content_descriptors.notes: Intense fear and horror with occasional jump scares.

Play as Linda, a high school student armed with a smartphone and camera, as she survives terrifying encounters and uncovers dark secrets across two chilling adventures. Will you survive the dread?
